blocks.tex:
The entire content reduces to the already-proven Menger chord identity
\cref{lem:menger_chord_identity} ($\kappa_i m_i = 2\sin\theta_i$) together with
the elementary fact that the signed twice-area of the triple is
$\ell_{i-1}\ell_i\sin\theta_i$. No arcsin branch analysis and no circle
geometry are needed downstream; that is the point of routing everything through
the chord identity.

blocks.title: Signed Menger curvature of a planar triple

blocks.label: def:cross_r2
blocks.title: signed twice-area
blocks.body:
For $A, B, C \in \mathbb{C}$ set
  \[
    \Delta(A,B,C) \;=\; \operatorname{Im}\bigl(\overline{(B-A)}\,(C-A)\bigr)
      \;=\; (B-A) \times (C-A),
  \]
  the $z$-component of the cross product; $\Delta = 2\cdot(\text{signed area
  of the oriented triangle } ABC)$, positive when $A,B,C$ turn left.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2
lean.code:
def crossR2 (A B C : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (B - A).re * (C - A).im - (B - A).im * (C - A).re

blocks.label: def:signed_menger_r2
blocks.title: signed Menger curvature
blocks.body:
For $A,B,C \in \mathbb{C}$ with pairwise distinct entries, the
  \emph{signed Menger curvature} of the ordered triple is
  \[
    \operatorname{sMenger}(A,B,C)
      \;=\; \frac{2\,\Delta(A,B,C)}
                 {|B-A|\,|C-B|\,|A-C|}.
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2
lean.code:
noncomputable def signedMengerR2 (A B C : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  2 * crossR2 A B C / (dist A B * dist B C * dist C A)

blocks.label: lem:smenger_invariant
blocks.title: isometry invariance
blocks.body:
$\operatorname{sMenger}$ is invariant under translation
  ($\operatorname{sMenger}(A+w, B+w, C+w) = \operatorname{sMenger}(A,B,C)$) and
  under rotation by any unit complex number $u$
  ($\operatorname{sMenger}(uA, uB, uC) = \operatorname{sMenger}(A,B,C)$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_add_left
lean.code:
lemma signedMengerR2_add_left (A B C w : ℂ) :
    signedMengerR2 (A + w) (B + w) (C + w) = signedMengerR2 A B C := by
  simp only [signedMengerR2, crossR2_add_left, dist_add_right]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.dist_mul_left_unit
lean.code:
lemma dist_mul_left_unit {u : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (A B : ℂ) :
    dist (u * A) (u * B) = dist A B := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← mul_sub, norm_mul, hu, one_mul]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_rotate
lean.code:
lemma crossR2_rotate {u : ℂ} (hu : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1) (A B C : ℂ) :
    crossR2 (u * A) (u * B) (u * C) = crossR2 A B C := by
  have h1 : u * B - u * A = u * (B - A) := by ring
  have h2 : u * C - u * A = u * (C - A) := by ring
  simp only [crossR2, h1, h2, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  linear_combination ((B - A).re * (C - A).im - (B - A).im * (C - A).re) * hu

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_add_left
lean.code:
lemma crossR2_add_left (A B C w : ℂ) :
    crossR2 (A + w) (B + w) (C + w) = crossR2 A B C := by
  have h1 : B + w - (A + w) = B - A := by ring
  have h2 : C + w - (A + w) = C - A := by ring
  simp only [crossR2, h1, h2]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_rotate
lean.code:
lemma signedMengerR2_rotate {u : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (A B C : ℂ) :
    signedMengerR2 (u * A) (u * B) (u * C) = signedMengerR2 A B C := by
  have hu2 : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq u
    rw [hu] at h
    have h2 := congrArg (· ^ 2) h.symm
    rwa [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), one_pow] at h2
  simp only [signedMengerR2, crossR2_rotate hu2, dist_mul_left_unit hu]

/-! ## Tangent–chord identity -/

variable {n : ℕ}

blocks.tex:
Translation cancels in every difference $B-A$, etc. For rotation by $|u|=1$:
  each difference scales by $u$, so $\Delta$ scales by $|u|^2 = 1$ (the cross
  product of $u(B-A), u(C-A)$ is $|u|^2$ times that of $B-A, C-A$) and each
  chord length is unchanged.

blocks.title: The tangent--chord law and the Menger bridge
remark
blocks.body:
(TC) is the Euclidean inscribed-angle theorem in disguise: $\omega$ is the angle
between the chord of length $\ell_i$ and the circle tangent at its endpoint, and
$\sin\omega = \kappa_i\ell_i/2 = (\ell_i/2)/R$. On $S^2/H^2$ the constant-angle
loci are not cycles (Lexell) and only the $t_K$-form survives; that is the
content deferred to the later geometries. Here (TC) is definitional because the
development is built from the arcsin terms directly.

blocks.label: thm:smenger_development
blocks.title: Euclidean Menger bridge, D2
blocks.body:
Let $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$. For every $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the
  signed Menger curvature of the three consecutive developed vertices equals the
  target curvature at the middle vertex:
  \[
    \operatorname{sMenger}\bigl(v_k,\; v_{k+1},\; v_{k+2}\bigr)
      \;=\; \kappa_{(k+1 \bmod n)} .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_development
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerR2_development {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    signedMengerR2 (vertexR2 κ ℓ k) (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1))
        (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1)) = κ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
  -- the two edge vectors of the middle triple
  have hu : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      = (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  have hw : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1)
      = (ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  set i : ZMod n := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) with hi
  set a : ℝ := ℓ (k : ZMod n) with ha
  set b : ℝ := ℓ i with hb
  set α : ℝ := heading κ ℓ k with hαd
  set β : ℝ := heading κ ℓ (k + 1) with hβd
  set θ : ℝ := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i with hθd
  rw [signedMengerR2_of_diffs hu hw]
  -- turning-angle relation β - α = θ
  have hθ : β - α = θ := by
    rw [hβd, heading_succ, ← hi, ← hθd, ← hαd]; ring
  -- edge components and norms
  rw [edge_re, edge_im, edge_re, edge_im]
  have hapos : 0 < a := h.length_pos (k : ZMod n)
  have hbpos : 0 < b := h.length_pos i
  -- the third side is the vertex chord
  have hnorm : ‖(a : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      + (b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((β : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = vertexChord κ ℓ i := by
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq, vertexChord]
    congr 1
    have hi1 : i - 1 = (k : ZMod n) := by rw [hi]; push_cast; ring
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, edge_re, edge_im]
    rw [hi1, ← ha, ← hb, ← hθd, ← hθ, Real.cos_sub]
    linear_combination a ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq α
      + b ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq β
  rw [edge_norm, edge_norm, abs_of_pos hapos, abs_of_pos hbpos, hnorm]
  -- final algebra through the Menger chord identity
  have hmenger : κ i * vertexChord κ ℓ i = 2 * Real.sin θ := by
    have := menger_chord_identity h i
    rwa [← hθd] at this
  have hvc := vertexChord_pos h i
  have hnum : a * Real.cos α * (b * Real.sin β) - a * Real.sin α * (b * Real.cos β)
      = a * b * Real.sin θ := by
    rw [← hθ, Real.sin_sub]; ring
  rw [hnum, show 2 * (a * b * Real.sin θ) = a * b * (2 * Real.sin θ) from by ring,
    ← hmenger]
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hapos
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hbpos
  have hvc0 : vertexChord κ ℓ i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hvc
  field_simp

/-! ## Menger realizability and the forward bridge -/

blocks.tex:
Write $i = k+1 \bmod n$ for the middle index. By the one-step recurrence
  (\cref{lem:development_recurrences}) the two edge vectors are
  $B - A = v_{k+1} - v_k = \ell_k\, e^{i\psi_k}$ and
  $C - B = v_{k+2} - v_{k+1} = \ell_{k+1}\, e^{i\psi_{k+1}}$, with headings
  differing by the turning angle $\psi_{k+1} - \psi_k = \theta_{i}$. The third
  side is $C - A = (B-A) + (C-B)$, whose length is exactly the vertex chord
  $m_i = |C-A|$ of \cref{def:vertex_chord} (the norm computation is the remark
  after that definition). The signed twice-area is
  \[
    \Delta(A,B,C) = (B-A)\times(C-A) = (B-A)\times(C-B)
      = \ell_k\,\ell_{k+1}\,\sin\theta_i
  \]
  (translation invariance kills the common term; the cross product of two
  vectors of lengths $\ell_k, \ell_{k+1}$ at angle $\theta_i$). Hence
  \[
    \operatorname{sMenger}(A,B,C)
      = \frac{2\,\ell_k\ell_{k+1}\sin\theta_i}
             {\ell_k\,\ell_{k+1}\,m_i}
      = \frac{2\sin\theta_i}{m_i}
      = \kappa_i
  \]
  where the last step is the Menger chord identity
  \cref{lem:menger_chord_identity} ($\kappa_i m_i = 2\sin\theta_i$), dividing by
  $m_i > 0$ (the chord is positive since $\ell_k, \ell_{k+1} > 0$ and the edges
  are not anti-parallel, $|\theta_i| < \pi$). Isometry invariance
  (\cref{lem:smenger_invariant}) is what lets the computation be carried out on
  the raw edge vectors rather than on the absolute vertex positions.

blocks.title: Menger realizability and the forward bridge

blocks.label: def:realizes_menger
blocks.title: signed-Menger realizability
blocks.body:
For $\kappa\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{R}$ (with $3 \le n$),
  $\mathrm{RealizesMenger}\,\kappa$ holds when there is a simple closed polygon
  $v\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{C}$ with
  $\operatorname{sMenger}(v_{i-1}, v_i, v_{i+1}) = \kappa_i$ for every
  $i\in\mathbb{Z}/n$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RealizesMenger

blocks.label: lem:vertex_eq_polygon
blocks.title: the development read at any natural index
blocks.body:
If $E(\kappa,\ell) = 0$ and $T(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$, then for every
  $j \in \mathbb{N}$ the developed vertex $v_j$ agrees with the cyclic polygon
  at the reduced index: $v_j = P(\kappa,\ell)(\overline{j})
  = v_{(\overline{j}).\mathrm{val}}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2_eq_polygon
lean.code:
lemma vertexR2_eq_polygon [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (m : ℕ) :
    vertexR2 κ ℓ m = polygonR2 κ ℓ (m : ZMod n) := by
  rw [polygonR2, ZMod.val_natCast]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div m n]
  exact vertexR2_add_mul_n hE hT (m % n) (m / n)

blocks.tex:
Write $j = (j \bmod n) + n\,(j \div n)$. Iterating the period identity
  $v_{k+n} = v_k$ of \cref{lem:development_periodic} exactly $j \div n$ times
  gives $v_j = v_{j \bmod n}$, and $(\overline{j}).\mathrm{val} = j \bmod n$ is
  the definition of the reduction.
